body:
Tested locally, it mostly works as expected.

**Testing project:** [test-multiple-cameras.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18563445/test-multiple-cameras.zip)

However, the issue that https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102014 addressed with the rotation gizmo appearing after restarting the editor is back, at least when previewing multiple cameras with multiple viewports:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fc8bc1b4-a5a9-4c9d-95f3-524ee17ea553)

It's possible that this also occurs with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102014 alone, as I didn't test multiple viewports back then.

Works great now :slightly_smiling_face: 

I can confirm the gizmos are gone on previewed viewports, even after a restart:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/74532b40-9d00-42e6-a702-e5208051991e)

It also works with Cinematic Preview.
